MENU Whistleblower
Hearing
Subcommittee: Railroads, Pipelines, and Hazardous Materials Date: Thursday, January 23, 2025 Time: 10:00 AM Location: 2167 Rayburn House Office Building

This content requires Flash Player version 9 (installed version: No Flash Flayer installed, or version is pre 6.0.0
Install Flash Player

Agenda

The hearing will discuss passenger and freight issues and the state of the railroad industry, including potential legislative considerations for a surface reauthorization bill.

Jared Cassity
Alternate National Safety and Legislative Director
Sheet Metal Air Rail Transprotation-Transportation Division (SMART-TD)
